rows.grounds: narakas (hell) in accusative plural; here carries the sense of from the hells
present middle third person plural of nivṛt
past participle of āhvā, masculine nominative singular

items.question: When do beings not return from hells?
premises: They do not return from hells.
items.inference: Return from the hells is withheld until the summoned deluge.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of summoned and deluge remains open.
items.plain_english: They do not return from the hells until the deluge is summoned.
